name: tt-local-generator
description: GTK4 desktop app for generating video, images, and generative art locally on Tenstorrent hardware — Wan2.2 text-to-video and character animation, SkyReels-V2, Mochi-1, FLUX.1 text-to-image, and AnimateDiff, plus a three-tier prompt generator (algorithmic, Markov, Qwen3-0.6B) to inspire them. Installs from the Tenstorrent PPA; model weights ship as separate tt-model-* packages, and an MCP server exposes every generator as a tool to Claude Code and other clients.
